title: Charming Guest Apartment near Nashville
description:
Charming 1BR retreat just 15 mins from BNA & 25 mins to downtown Nashville! Relax in comfort with a queen bed, sofa sleeper, full kitchen, high-speed Wi-Fi & smart TV. Nestled between Percy Priest & Old Hickory Lake, our peaceful town offers easy access to Music City fun without the crowds. Perfect for exploring Nashville, visiting family, or house hunting in Middle Tennessee. We are tucked away in a quiet neighborhood that is great for walks.

The space
1 bedroom with Queen-size bed (very comfy!)

Sliding barn door for added privacy

Queen-size sofa sleeper in living area

TV in both bedroom and living room with Roku

Kitchen Includes:

- Refrigerator

- Stovetop & oven

- Microwave

- Toaster

- Keurig coffee maker

- Cooking basics (pots, pans, salt & pepper)

- Dishware & flatware

Guest access
Keyless entry, code to be provided on day of check-in once apartment is ready.

Other things to note
- No smoking of any kind
- No events, parties, or large gatherings
- Property is on septic tank - only TP in toilet and no solids down sink
